_note: Organisation Goals — appended onto the bundled src/manifest.json by main.js::mergeManifestFragments (ADR-037). Declarative core only: index + detail pages for the goal register; schema ref BY SLUG (goal), never PascalCase. No new Vue component (organisation-goals REQ-009) — generic data/related widgets only, same shape as src/manifest.d/termijnagenda.json. Menu placement: this fragment declares menu id 'Goals' as a CONTRACT — the concurrent ia-six-clusters change has already forward-declared the relocation "Goals": "ActionItems" in src/menu-layout.json, so this entry is swallowed into the 'Tasks & Commitments' (ActionItems) cluster group once merged; this fragment does not edit src/menu-layout.json or openspec/changes/ia-six-clusters/ (organisation-goals REQ-009 Scenario 2).

config._note: Goals index (REQ-009). Columns title/body/horizon/deadline/status; quick filters on status (horizon and body are facetable and available via the index sidebar facets).

GoalDetail (REQ-001/002/004/005/009). Goal data (title/description/horizon/body/owner/startDate/deadline/status/targetValue/currentValue/unit) plus the declarative rollup fields (linkedCommitmentCount/settledCommitmentCount/commitmentSettlementRate, linkedActionItemCount/completedActionItemCount/actionItemCompletionRate, childGoalCount/achievedChildGoalCount/childGoalAchievedRate) render as plain fields in the data widget, same posture as the Meeting quorum aggregation display — no custom progress-visualisation widget (design.md Non-Goals). parentGoal/owner/body render as resolved references in the Related widget.

widgets.title: Steps
widgets._note: goals-linked-to-decisions REQ-014: Draft, Active and Achieved with their dates (created, startDate, deadline).

widgets.title: Progress
widgets._note: goals-linked-to-decisions REQ-012: target value, commitments settled, action items done and sub-goals reached as "x of y"; a line whose total is zero is hidden. Custom because a stats tile shows one number, not a count against a total over three schemas.

widgets.title: Parent goal
widgets._note: goals-linked-to-decisions REQ-014: the parent's title as a link and how many of its sub-goals are reached.

widgets.title: Sub-goals
widgets._note: goals-linked-to-decisions REQ-014: the goals whose parentGoal is this one. Add sub-goal opens the goal form; the list seeds parentGoal from its filter.

widgets.title: Contributions
widgets._note: goals-linked-to-decisions REQ-011: every commitment, action item, planned agenda item and decision that names this goal, with the total and View all n. Custom because it joins four schemas into one list.
